description: Deterministic estimate from the merchant's own data: item price x quantity plus the shipping options the store declares for the destination (flat rate = declared base rate; free shipping with its threshold, whether this quantity reaches it and how much is missing). Lists what is not included (shipping classes, cost formulas, duties, taxes on shipping). Pass variation_id for variable products. Valid within max_age_seconds of the last merchant confirmation; live=true reads the merchant now. The checkout is the only authority.

destination.description: ISO 3166-1 country, optionally with region: "IT" or "IT:CB".

name: estimate_delivered_cost
title: Estimate the delivered cost of one offer to a destination
